content.description: Illustration showing two locations on the cylinder block where seal packing should be applied, with arrows pointing to specific areas

items: (a) Apply seal packing to the two locations shown.
(b) Place a new head gasket over the dowels on the cylinder block.

content.description: Diagram showing cylinder head positioned over dowels with numbered bolt tightening sequence from 1-12, and an SST tool illustration below

items: (a) Position the cylinder head over dowels on the block.
(b) Using SST, install and tighten the head bolts gradually in three passes and in the sequence shown. Torque the bolts on the final pass.

content.description: Diagram of timing belt cover showing bolt locations with measurements: 28 (1.10) at two nut positions and 43 (1.69) at bolt position, with bolt length indicated in mm (in.)

items: (a) Position a new gasket on the cylinder head.
(b) Install the No. 2 timing belt cover with three bolts and two nuts.

content.description: Illustration showing the oil pressure regulator assembly positioned on the cylinder head

items: (a) Position a new gasket on the cylinder head.
(b) Install the oil pressure regulator with three bolts.
(c) Install the timing belt cover stay with two bolts.

content.text: INSTALL CAMSHAFT TIMING PULLEYS AND TIMING BELT
(See steps 9 to 14 on page EM-15 to 17)

content.description: Illustration showing exhaust manifold with seven bolt locations indicated by arrows

items: (a) Position a new gasket on the cylinder head.
(b) Install the exhaust manifold with seven nuts. Torque the nuts.
